name: Cases from the Desk of Harrie Noire
source:
Sixteen year old Tabitha Quaile, a sophomore at a private girls' school, teams up with twenty-six year old Harrie Noire, a quirky private investigator, to solve mysteries.

The Incident at Liliwen Academy serves to see the two protagonists join forces for the first time to solve the case of a destroyed racing shell.

[From [url=https://spcyaya.itch.io/harrienoire]itch.io[/url]]
